_about: Slim profiles for worktrees: tracked folders an agent's worktree does not need, left out with git sparse-checkout (reversible: `git sparse-checkout disable` in that worktree brings them back). Keyed by the main checkout's folder name. Only big, write-once material: run evidence, review screenshots, archived docs. Measured 25 Sep 2026 on oracle set-b: 2,177 MB tracked, these paths ~1,100 MB.

oracle-streaming.keep_note: .uihub/dashboard and .uihub/review-board are read by the app (dest/main/index.ts, dev-web/main.web.ts): kept
